 Jordan Watkins goes for 22 yards in Week 6 
 by Matthew Adam | 49ers Correspondent | Tue, Oct 20th 2026, 5:52am EDT 
 Jordan Watkins caught his lone target for a 22-yard gain in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Watkins was quiet in the win. The veteran receiver could see a larger role in Week 7 vs. the Falcons, with Mike Evans (Achilles soreness) not expected to play. Watkins has caught just three passes for 82 yards on the season.
